lines.en: I flick my tail to catch the one ahead.
The school turns and I turn with it.
I swim up close along the coral seams.

lines.zh: 红草甸的水暖，游得轻快。
lines.en: The red meadow water is warm and I swim light.
Twelve of us squeeze through at once.

lines.zh: 我游在队伍中间，最安全。
lines.en: I swim in the middle of the line, safest there.
One flick of my fin and I slip into coral.

lines.zh: 前面有影子，我先沉下去。
lines.en: A shadow ahead makes me sink lower first.

lines.zh: 我们绕着礁石转了一圈。
lines.en: We circle the whole reef once together.

lines.zh: 水浅的地方，我游得更快。
lines.en: In shallow water I swim a good deal faster.

lines.zh: 尾鳍拍水，像有人在点头。
lines.en: My tail beats the water like a nodding head.

lines.zh: 我跟丢了，又赶快追回去。
lines.en: I fell behind and hurried back to the school.
A file of small fish threads the seagrass bed.
We never scatter; scattered is how we die.

lines.zh: 我躲在大鱼后面，借它的影子。
lines.en: I hide behind a bigger fish and borrow its shadow.

lines.zh: 礁缝太窄，我侧着身子过。
lines.en: The reef gap is narrow, so I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 队伍拐了个弯，我差点撞上珊瑚。
lines.en: The school turned and I nearly hit the coral.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就知道游到深处了。
lines.en: The water cooled; I have reached deeper ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的尾巴，不敢落后。
lines.en: I hug my neighbor's tail, afraid to fall behind.

lines.zh: 沙子扬起来，我们一齐换了方向。
lines.en: Sand rises and we all change direction at once.
I hang motionless above the coral.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子在我背上游。
lines.en: Coral shadows crawl along my back.
My companions press in on every side.
I open my mouth; water leaves by my gills.
A large fish swims past above me.
I counted, and three of us are missing.
The red weeds sway slowly in the water.
I hide behind a single branch of coral.

lines.zh: 眼睛大，看得远，也怕得早。
lines.en: Big eyes see far, and fear comes early.
Sunlight reaches the seabed and dazzles me.
I press close to the sand and hold still.
A companion pushes in and I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的鳞，有点痒。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my scales and tickles.

lines.zh: 我们安静地漂着，等天黑。
lines.en: We drift quietly and wait for the dark.
You are one huge shape in the water.
I watch you from behind my companions.
You hold still, and so do all of us.
I know that net you carry.
Do not come closer; we will scatter.
One twitch of your finger and I retreat.
Have you come for the whole school?
I am so small, not even one mouthful.

lines.zh: 你腰上的灯照得我眼花。
lines.en: The lamp at your waist blinds my eyes.
All of us are watching you, so relax.
A scale is gone and it stings.
There is blood in the water, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 撞得我在水里打了个滚。
lines.en: The hit sent me tumbling through the water.
My companions fled and left me behind.
A wound this small is enough to sink me.
I hug the sand, too hurt to swim.
Whatever bit me has enormous teeth.
I hide in the coral and gulp water.
My tail fin is split, so I swim crooked.
Six points of life drain away fast.
Is that crumb enough for all of us?
I smell something fishy and drift closer.
I will not grab; I let the others eat first.

lines.zh: 你把食撒开，我们才敢来。
lines.en: Scatter the food and only then will we come.

lines.zh: 这么小一颗，我一口就完。
lines.en: One crumb this small is gone in a bite.
My companions move, so I move too.
Not the net; set it down with your hand.
Food in warm water smells much sweeter.
I swim half a circle, then back away.
They are watching me, so I hold still.
You touched the school and it burst apart.
I got squeezed into a full spin.
One bump and I am dazed for a while.

lines.zh: 十二条一起躲，乱成一团。
lines.en: Twelve of us dodge at once, a total mess.

lines.zh: 我撞到珊瑚，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: I hit the coral and lost a scale.
Your foot lands and the sand billows up.

lines.zh: 我们往两边分开，再合上。
lines.en: We split to both sides, then join again.

lines.zh: 别挤，后面的还在往前推。
lines.en: Stop pushing; the ones behind still shove forward.

lines.zh: 我被撞到石缝里，出不来。
lines.en: I was knocked into a crack and cannot get out.
You bump harder than a shark does.

lines.zh: 撞完我贴地游，怕再来一下。
lines.en: After that I hug the sand, fearing another hit.

lines.zh: 整群绕开你，像水绕开石头。
lines.en: The school flows around you like water round stone.

lines.zh: 我摆出最亮的鳞给她看。
lines.en: I show her the brightest of my scales.
Two small fish circle round each other.

lines.zh: 她游得比我快，我追不上。
lines.en: She swims faster than me; I cannot keep up.
In warm water the school grows livelier.
We press side by side against the coral.
She touches my tail fin, and I understand.
Only a crowded school raises young.
I stay by her side and do not swim far.
We cannot see well, so we touch instead.
Even a fish this small chooses a partner.
I snatch a piece of food and dart off.
It is tiny and fits neatly in my mouth.
My companions chase me, so I dive into coral.

lines.zh: 沙上有一片鳞，我叼走了。
lines.en: A scale lies on the sand; I carry it off.
Whose crumb is this? I am keeping it.

lines.zh: 咬着东西游，速度慢一半。
lines.en: Swimming with food in my mouth halves my speed.
I hide under a stone to eat it slowly.
My mouth is full and will not close.
What I grabbed stays in, never spat out.
This one bite lasts me a whole day.
The ripples break, so something is there.
Only things smaller than me count as food.
That dark shape is far too close.
I stare at it and my fins go stiff.
It is coming this way; scatter now.
Something is rooting around in the sand.
Food or teeth? I need a closer look.
My companions fled and left me alone.
I squeeze deeper into the coral.
It opened its mouth; I should leave.
It circles, so I hug the coral line.

lines.zh: 我数着它的鳍，一下一下。
lines.en: I count its finbeats, one after another.
Its eyes are not fixed on me.
I sink deeper where the light is thin.
Its fin tilts, and I change course at once.
The seagrass blocks its line of sight.

lines.zh: 我躲在同伴中间，看不出来。
lines.en: I hide among companions and blend right in.
It slows down, so I slow down more.
One more step closer and I bolt away.

lines.zh: 四周安静，我听见自己摆鳍。
lines.en: All is quiet; I hear my own fins beating.
I bite its tail once and let go at once.
Teeth this small can barely scratch.
It thrashes and I get flung away.
I ram its eye; that counts as a blow.
Bite, then run; never look back.
Our whole school swarms in to peck it.
Its hide is thick and my teeth ache.
I clamp the fin edge and will not let go.
This bite may cost me my life.

lines.zh: 打得赢就咬，打不赢就游。
lines.en: Bite if I can win; swim if I cannot.
Twelve of us arrived all at once.
I open my eyes inside the coral reef.
The water is warm, so I flick my tail.
Companions press on me; I cannot get out.
The red meadow weeds stand taller than me.
First I find the school, then I find food.
Born already hiding from sharks.

lines.zh: 我这么小，活下来算运气。
lines.en: Being this small, surviving is pure luck.
In warm water we huddle into one ball.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，跟上第一批同伴。
lines.en: I flick my tail and follow the first group.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我鳞片卷起来。
lines.en: The hot water curls my scales right up.

lines.zh: 浪把我抛起来，摔在礁面。
lines.en: A wave threw me up and down onto the reef.
I am in water yet cannot draw breath.
The water bursts and I fly clean out.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过我的鳍。
lines.en: Something sharp passes right through my fin.
A strange current runs through me and I shake.
The school scattered and I ate nothing for days.
A white flash in the water freezes me.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，周围全黑了。
lines.en: I fall and everything around me goes black.
